name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit: Free LPG connection for women from BPL households
verification_note: Seed data written from public knowledge; confirm rules, amounts and URLs on the official source before relying on them.

documents.name: BPL card or SECC household proof
Aadhaar (identity only — do not enter the number in this app)

steps: Visit the nearest LPG distributor with your documents
Fill the Ujjwala application form and submit it with a copy of your BPL card
Complete the KYC and connection process at the distributor
Note the distributor and application details, and check the connection status with the distributor
